steps.what: Follow gaming regulations, checking required procedures and escalating uncertain cases

tasks.enabler_now: Existing approved procedures remain available without new software.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising exceptions and circumstances requiring escalation.
tasks.human_edge: Noticing when nominally complete information does not resolve the concern.
tasks.altitude: Compliance responsibility and time remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Applying establishment-specific gambling procedures requires contextual checks; no task-specific labour reduction is established.

tasks.human_edge: Verifying what was physically presented and what is physically handed over.
tasks.altitude: A small arithmetic gain leaves physical exchange responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Fixed denominations and verified quantities support deterministic totals; the proposed saving is unmeasured and excludes physical handling.

tasks.short: Count funds and reconcile daily transactions

steps.what: Count funds and capture drawer balances against complete daily transaction records
Calculate daily summaries and compare expected funds with the verified count
Reconcile differences, document explanations and approve the balanced daily books

tasks.design: Configure daily summaries and expected-versus-counted comparisons in the cage transaction system {OTHER}. Retain physical counting, discrepancy investigation and approved balance entry in {ERP} with the worker.
tasks.previous_blocker: Summing transaction categories and comparing them to counted funds can require repeat manual arithmetic.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit opening balances, transaction scope and counts support fixed reconciliation rules.
tasks.still_hard: Missing transactions, reversals and explaining physical differences.
tasks.human_edge: Investigating discrepancies rather than forcing an apparent balance.
tasks.altitude: Reduce arithmetic and retain responsibility for cash custody and reconciliation.

evidence.claim: Explicit transaction records and verified cash counts support deterministic reconciliation summaries; the task-specific saving is unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is end-of-day counting and reconciliation, excluding individual patron transactions and physical banking.

Worker produces drawer ID, period, opening balance, denomination counts, transaction cutoff and verified record completeness in s1; capture time remains included. Original transactions are recorded during unchanged counter work and receive no additional saving here.
The {OTHER} slot is the cage transaction system. Test native reconciliation first; incomplete records or unsupported categories require manual reconciliation, never fabricated discrepancy codes.
Existing automatic totals and unchanged supervisor approval earn no new savings credit; any required further authorization remains in the normal process.
research_questions: Can configured summaries save time after physical counting and discrepancy investigation are included?
